changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2 0.7: QPER + knob locks the linked performance and QPER + YES writes it into the kit; in LIVE RECORDING the quick perf rec keeps performance moves, RECORD + YES writes them into the pattern as locks and RECORD + NO clears them.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
